title: 3EN security stack end-to-end audit
description: Large read-only end-to-end audit of the known 3EN security stack components on OpenWrt and Windows. Verifies banIP, custom nftables set en3_block4, firewall references, rsyslog forwarding, 3en-net-health, cron, listeners, recent security logs, and Windows reachability/DNS. No configuration or block rules are changed.
script:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $Key=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.ssh\3en002_agent_ed25519'; $ssh=(Get-Command ssh.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source; Write-Host '=== 3EN SECURITY STACK E2E AUDIT 014 ==='; Write-Host ('Time='+(Get-Date -Format o)); $remote=@'
echo '=== BANIP_STATUS ==='
banip-status 2>&1 || /etc/init.d/banip status 2>&1 || true
echo
echo '=== EN3_BLOCK4_SET ==='
nft list set inet fw4 en3_block4 2>&1 || true
echo
echo '=== EN3_BLOCK4_RULE_REFERENCES ==='
nft list ruleset 2>/dev/null | grep -n -C 2 'en3_block4' || true
echo
echo '=== FIREWALL_RELEVANT ==='
uci show firewall 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'banip|block|reject|wan|forward|input' || true
echo
echo '=== LOG_FORWARDING ==='
ps w | grep 'logread' | grep -v grep || true
uci show system 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'log_ip|log_port|hostname' || true
echo
echo '=== HEALTHCHECK_FILE ==='
ls -l /root/3en-net-health.sh 2>/dev/null || true
sha256sum /root/3en-net-health.sh 2>/dev/null || true
echo
echo '=== CRON ==='
cat /etc/crontabs/root 2>/dev/null || true
echo
echo '=== SERVICE_STATUS ==='
/etc/init.d/banip status 2>&1 || true
/etc/init.d/firewall status 2>&1 || true
/etc/init.d/uhttpd status 2>&1 || true
/etc/init.d/dropbear status 2>&1 || true
/etc/init.d/dnsmasq status 2>&1 || true
/etc/init.d/cron status 2>&1 || true
echo
echo '=== LISTENERS ==='
netstat -lntup 2>/dev/null || ss -lntup 2>/dev/null || true
echo
echo '=== RECENT_SECURITY_LOGS ==='
logread -l 700 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'banip|blocked|reject|dropbear|failed login|3en|firewall|wan' | tail -n 500 || true
echo
echo '=== E2E_AUDIT_END ==='
'@; $remote | & $ssh -i $Key -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 root@192.168.1.2 'sh -s' 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw '014 OpenWrt audit failed'}; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '=== WINDOWS_SIDE_VALIDATION ==='; foreach($ip in '192.168.1.2','192.168.1.3'){ $r=Test-NetConnection -ComputerName $ip -InformationLevel Detailed -WarningAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ('TARGET='+$ip+' PING='+$r.PingSucceeded+' IF='+$r.InterfaceAlias+' SRC='+$r.SourceAddress) }; foreach($p in 22,80,443){$t=Test-NetConnection -ComputerName 192.168.1.2 -Port $p -WarningAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ('ROUTER_PORT_'+$p+'='+$t.TcpTestSucceeded)}; $dns=Resolve-DnsName google.com -Type A -DnsOnly -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object {$_.IPAddress} | Select-Object -First 3 -ExpandProperty IPAddress; Write-Host ('DNS_GOOGLE='+($dns -join ',')); $pi=Resolve-DnsName pi.hole -Type A -DnsOnly -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object {$_.IPAddress} | Select-Object -First 3 -ExpandProperty IPAddress; Write-Host ('DNS_PIHOLE='+($pi -join ',')); Write-Host 'E2E_014=PASS'
test: Write-Host '3EN SECURITY STACK E2E AUDIT 014 COLLECTION PASS'
